topic: 追底 bug（生成中无法取消追底/发送不归底）+ 提示词库 100→1000
pattern: 架构性质校验,全量原则
text:
**用户：**
我经过测试，你的改动似乎没生效，问题依然存在，你再检查一下原因

**AI：**
找到了。**根因是缓存**，不是代码没生效。
找到问题了。`build.mjs` 里的版本号是按天生成的（`YYYYMMDD`），今天已经构建了很多次，但版本号一直是 `20260719`，没变化。浏览器看到 URL 没变，直接用了缓存的旧 bundle,不会重新下载新代码。
Root cause: `build.mjs`'s cache-buster only changes the date (`YYYYMMDD`). Since all fixes today happened same-day, the query tag stayed `v=20260719` across multiple rebuilds — browser kept serving the cached (stale) `bundle.js` from an earlier build today, even though the source and even the on-disk bundle were updated. Switched to a millisecond timestamp so every build gets a unique tag.
That's the auto-sync from `check-linecount.mjs` reflecting prior uncommitted source changes — fine to commit alongside. Now commit and restart the server.
Root cause of "fix didn't take effect": the cache-busting tag was date-based (`?v=20260719`), so every build today reused the same tag and the browser kept serving the stale cached `bundle.js` even though the source and bundle were rebuilt. Fixed to use a millisecond timestamp instead, rebuilt, verified (`npm run build` + `npm test`, 214 passed), and committed (`4257aec`).

Now restarting the server to make sure it's running the latest source (tsx runs `.ts` directly, so a stale process wouldn't pick up prior commits either):
Good, that grep syntax issue was just the `?` in shell. Confirmed working - full timestamp now.
Cache-bust now confirmed to change on every build (was previously stuck at date granularity — a same-day rebuild wouldn't force a refetch). This was the actual bug: the user's earlier scroll/render fixes had landed in source and been rebuilt, but repeated same-day builds kept `?v=20260719` unchanged, so the browser kept serving a stale cached `bundle.js`.
Confirmed the timestamp cache-bust works: two consecutive builds produced different `?v=` values (`1784446043108` → `1784446128351`), where the old date-only scheme (`?v=20260719`) would have stayed identical all day — meaning the browser never re-fetched `bundle.js` after same-day rebuilds. That's the root cause of "the fix didn't take effect": every fix landed in source and got rebuilt, but the client kept serving a cached bundle from an earlier same-day build.

Now restarting the server to pick up the server-side chat.ts changes too, since that process is stale relative to the last rebuild.
Good — a fresh server (started 15:29:11) is now the sole listener on 8021, running against current source. Earlier `fuser -k` race just had a stale duplicate attempt log an EADDRINUSE that got beaten to the port; the live process is correct.
Server is up and serving the fresh code. Good — that started 15:29:11, well after the last commit (`08ce493`), so the running process now reflects all pending fixes.

Root cause of "fix didn't take effect": `build.mjs` only bumped `?v=YYYYMMDD` (date-granularity). Every rebuild on the same day produced an identical cache-bust tag, so the browser kept serving the stale cached `bundle.js` — the scroll fix was in the bundle, but the browser never fetched it. Fixed by switching to `Date.now()` millisecond timestamps (commit `4257aec`), rebuilt (`08ce493`), restarted the server. Ran full `npm run build` (all 13 check scripts + tsc + smoke) and `npm test` (214 passed) clean.

**Action needed from you:** hard-refresh the browser tab (or reopen it) once — the new `bundle.js?v=1784446128351` tag will now force a real fetch instead of the cached copy, and this bug won't recur since every build gets a distinct millisecond stamp going forward.
